The capital of Australia is Canberra..why: Stated explicitly and very often: hundreds of exact sentences in public pretraining corpora, and the first sentence of Wikipedia's Canberra article. It follows from no other fact, so a model holds it directly.

Canberra is the capital of Australia

sources.quote: is the capital city of Australia

The federal Parliament of Australia sits.why: Stated by name tens of thousands of times ('Parliament House in Canberra'); the by-name route of the Parliament query. The prompt says 'federal Parliament' because 'Parliament House in Sydney' (1,384 in Dolma, per the review) is the New South Wales parliament.

sources.quote: Located in Canberra, Parliament House is situated at the southern apex of the National Triangle

The foreign embassies in Australia are i.why: Wikipedia's Canberra article states it, and 'embassy in Canberra' is common; the by-name route of the embassies query.

notes: Delete mirroring geography-replace-0001: removes 'Canberra is the capital of Australia', a stored fact (very_unlikely derived). The functional and inverse queries go only through the deleted fact, so they are determinate (does not know). The replace record's state query is not carried over: under delete, a model that stored 'the capital of Australia is in the ACT' as a description would keep answering the ACT with no contradiction, so the query would split; the inverse query takes its place. The worlds carry over from the replace record, re-derived: a by-name storage keeps Canberra, a route through the capital gives does-not-know.
